   - Colorless solution (rules out colored transition metals)
   - Forms white precipitate with OH- that doesn't dissolve in excess (Mg(OH)2)
   - Forms white precipitate with carbonate (MgCO3)
   - Forms white precipitate with phosphate (MgNH4PO4)

The unknown salt is **MgSO4** (magnesium sulfate).
